en-US.longDescription: A cross-platform desktop GUI for svgo-kt (a Kotlin port of SVGO). SVGPaw allows you to open or drag & drop SVG files, fine-tune SVGO optimization plugins with a live visual preview, compare original vs. optimized side-by-side, and batch process SVGs locally without needing Node.js or a browser.
en-US.name: SVGPaw
